title: Constructors and Invariants
goal: Instantiate a struct with private fields using its constructor function.
hints: Private fields prevent struct literal construction outside the module.
Call the associated constructor function on the struct type.
explanation: Calling `bank::Account::open(100)` uses the public constructor function. Constructing a struct literal directly fails when any field is private. Calling `bank::Account` as a function fails with `E0423` because `Account` is a type name, not a function.
